tei:div.tei:p: (1na)tshogs chos mu tig gi phreng ba bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ chos gsha' ma gcig byed pa la dang po mi rtag pa bsgom pa gal che ste/ de med na/ chos byas tshad tshe 'di'i 'dun grogs su 'gro ba'i dogs pa yod/ mi rtag pa bsgom pa la dgos ched ci yod na/ tshe 'di la blo ldog pa'i dgos pa yod/ mi rtag pa bsgoms pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad mi rtag par shes pas/ tshe 'di la blo mi 'jug par 'dug na/ mi rtag pa bsgom pa'i dgos pa yin/ tshe 'di la blo ma log na/ mi rtag pa bsgom pa'i dgos pa med/ dang po mi rtag pa bsgoms nas tshe 'di la blo ldog par byas na/ de nas 'khor ba'i nyes skyon bsgom pa yin te/ 'khor ba'i nyes skyon bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag las blo ldog dgos pas log par byas nas/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin te/ de yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi (2na)sems bsgom pa ni/ dang po sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya'o bsam pa cig snying phugs su bcug nas ci byed pa de sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs par byas nas/ rang 'dod la gang yang ma zhugs par byas nas/ theg pa chen po'i blo sna'i sems bskyed nas gzhan don du dmigs pa ni/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ gzung 'dzin bdag dang tha dad kyi rnam rtog thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub pa'i ngang du blo mal du 'khyer ba yin te/ spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad la de bzhin du nyams su blang na don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa bya ba yin te/ de bzhin du nyams su blangs pas don dam pa byang chub kyi sems rtogs nas 'ong ba yin/ chos de las ma mchis gsung*/ rnam pa kun la snyan du gsol ba'i chos kyi dbang du bgyis (2ba)na/

da lta'i skabs su mno bsam dum re btang dgos te/ soms dang tshe 'di mi rtag par 'dug /nam mkha'i glog dang*/ chu'i chu bur dang*/ rtsa kha'i zil pa dang 'dra bar 'dug pas/ yong cis kyang phan pa med snyam pa cig snying phugs su gzhug dgos/ de lta bu cig phugs su bcug nas nyams su blangs dgos te/ sangs rgya bar byed pa la lam tshang la ma nor ba cig dgos/ lam tshang la ma nor ba de gang yin na/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum tshang ba cig la zer ba yin te/ de yang dang po sbyor ba ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems cig sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi ci byed pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan du lam du 'khyer ba yin te/ tha na sprang yon cig ster yang*/ sbyin pa'i dngos po de rang yin/ zhi bas ster ba de tshul khrims yin/ slong mi mkhas par 'dug kyang*/ de la nyon mongs mi skye bar 'dug pa de bzod pa yin/ myur du ster ba de brtson 'grus yin/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems gsum gyis bzung nas de la ma yengs par ster ba de bsam gtan yin/ slong mkhan ster mkhan dngos po 'bras bu thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes pa de shes rab yin/ de ltar dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan du shes par byas nas nyams su blangs shing*/ rjes la gang du yang mi dmigs pa'i rgya yis thebs par byas nas/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du gsal yang ma grub par lam du 'khyer ba yin te/ de bzhin du byas pas dang po sems can gyi don du blos zin pa ste theg pa chen po'i blo yin/ sangs rgya ba yang theg pa chen pos sangs rgyas pa las theg pa chung ngus bag (3na)tsam sangs mi rgya bas des na/ theg pa chen po'i blo sna re skye ba gal che/ dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba yin la/ rjes la mi dmigs pa'i rtsi yis zin pas/

thams cad nam mkha' lta bur shes pa cig 'ong ba yin/ de ltar shes pas kun gzhi la bag chags mi 'jog pa cig yong ba yin/ kun gzhi la bag chags ma bsags pas las kyi rten med/ rten med pas las bzang ngan gyi rjes su mi 'breng*/ de tsam na skye ba mi len pas de ka la sangs rgyas zer ba yin/ de ltar shes na lam tshang la ma nor ba yin/ da ltar gyi dus su lam tshang la ma nor ba cig nyams su blangs nas/ don thams cad grub pa cig ma bgyis na mal gyi tha ma na nyal/ zas kyi tha ma chu thigs cig 'thung*/ dbugs ring thung byed tsa na cis kyang mi stongs pas de bas da lta rang nas 'bad pas nyams su blangs la gdeng du tshud par bya dgos so// chos de las ma mchis// rnam pa kun la chos cig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ lam bsags sbyangs gnyis nyams su len dgos te/ tshogs gsog cing sgrib pa sbyong ba gal che/ tshe 'di nam mkha'i glog la sogs pa dang 'dra bar 'dug pas/ nam yal nas 'gro cha mi 'dug pas/ cis kyang dgos pa med pa cig snying phugs su bcug la/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gal che ste/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems skye ba yin pas 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa 'di gal che/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas byams snying rje bsgom/ de nas rang don spangs nas gzhan don ci 'grub byed pa gcig dgos pa yin/ sangs rgya bar byed pa la dang po yang sems can gyi don byed (3ba)par 'dod pa cig dgos/ bar du yang sangs rgya ba la sems can gyi don byed pa cig dgos/ tha ma yang sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don las byar med pa'o// des na dang por 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom/ bar du 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom/ tha ma la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis sems can gyi don 'ba' zhig byed pa ste kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin no// don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa na tshe snga ma'i sbyangs pa dang*/

rang gi rtsol ba dang*/ bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa gsum 'dzom dgos pa lags/ tshe snga ma'i sbyangs pa med na/ da lta dal 'byor mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan tshang ba mi yong la/ skye ba snga ma la tshogs bsags bsags pa'i sbyangs pa can dgos pa yin/ de yang rang gis rtsol ba ma byas par le lo'i lam du lus te/ 'phags pa'i lam mi thob/ bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na/ yon tan ci yang mi 'phel te/ rang la ci yang mi yong*/ byung yang nub nas bsod nams chu bcad pa bzhin 'gro ba ste/ lung las/ bla ma med na srid mthar min// skya ba 'dzin pa med pa yis// grus ni pha rol phyin mi 'gyur// zhes bshad pa lta bu'o// des na dang po sbyangs pa yod pa/ rang gis rtsol bas bsgrubs pa/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi lam gyi mthar thug gi dam tshig yin pas/ des na dam tshig la nan tan du srungs shig /gdams pa yang tshig shes pa gcig pus mi phan te/ ne tso'i 'don pa dang 'dra bas/ bla ma rnams kyis kyang bsgrubs pas grub pa thob pa yin pas/ 'o skol kyang bla ma la mos gus gyis/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas gdams pa tshul bzhin sgrub pa nyams su blangs pas/ (4na)grub rtags sna tshogs 'byung ba yin te/ bla ma tai lo par nā ro pas lo bcu gnyis bsten te/ bla ma la mos gus byas pas/ gdams pa dngos su gsungs pa med kyang bla ma la gus pas/ bla mas ji ltar gsung ba ltar bsgrubs/ grub rtags sna tshogs byung ba yin te/ des na bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ slob ma snod ldan gnyis 'dzom na/ skad cig ma rang la yon tan thams cad grub nas 'ong ste/ dang po zhi ba dang*/ gnas pa/ bar du gsal ba dang*/ mi rtog pa/ tha ma spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba/ nam mkha' lta bu'i don la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnas pa 'ong gsung*/ lung las kyang*/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas// skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// ces gsungs pa'o// des na dad pa dang sgrub pa nyams su len pa kho na gal che bas/

de bzhin du ma bgyis na nam zhig lag ngar sngas su bcug /yid gar chu las mi 'ong ba'i dus de tsa na/ rang gi nyams su blangs pa'i chos min pa gzhan gyis cis kyang mi phan pas/ de bas da lta rang nas nyams len la 'bad pa gal che gsung*/ chos de las ma mchis so// //rnam pa kun la snyan du gsol ba'i chos kyi dbang du bgyis na/ chos gsha' ma cig byed na tshe la long med du shes nas/ blo sna thung nge ba cig gis/ byams pa snying rje bsgom pa gal che/ de la skye lugs gsum yin te/ sems can la dmigs pa dang*/ chos la dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'o// dang po sems can la dmigs nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye ba ni/ de kho na nyid ma rtogs pas gzung 'dzin gyi sdug bsngal dang ldan pa'i sems can la dmigs te/ sems can sdug (4ba)bsngal dang bral bde ba dang phrad nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob na ci ma rung snyam du bsam zhing*/ gang dang gang ci dang ci byed pa thams cad la rang 'dod ma zhugs par jo bo sems can gyi don byed pa yin te/ jo bo sems can la brten nas bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin pas na/ sems can la dmigs pa gal che/ sems can blos spang na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi srid pas na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'di gtso che ba yin pas/ shin tu gces pa lags gsung*/ chos la dmigs te byang chub kyi sems skye ba ni chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma yin pas/ ci byed thams cad rmi lam sgyu mar 'khyer ba yin te/ lung las/ sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la// sgyu ma lta bu'i bsgoms byas na// sgyu ma lta bur sangs rgyas 'thob// ces gsungs so// chos rnams thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes nas/ zhe sdang ma grub pas zhe sdang rang sar grol nas 'ong ba yin/ de la sogs te chags sdang thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes te/

chags sdang gang la yang blo mi 'jug pa yin/ nyal 'dug las thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur nyams su blangs na/ snang ba'i bden 'dzin zhig pa la tshegs med/ de ni nyams su blangs pas tshe 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la tshegs med/ de ltar chos la dmigs pa ni byang chub kyi sems bya ba yin/ dmigs pa med pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni/ spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba la ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa'i don nyams su len pa cig yin te/ de lta bu'i don rtogs pa kun na re/ sha ba rgya nang du chud pa bzhin 'gro ba ni (5na)snying re rje 'gro rgyu med par ma rtogs na/ bla ma a ti shas gsung*/ bsgom bya sgom byed med pa'i spros bral 'gro 'ong med pa'i nyams de ltar nyams su blang na 'ong ba yin pas/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye lugs gsum yin pas/ de bzhin du nyams su blang*/ chos de las ma mchis so// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig 'chad pa'i dbang du bgyis na/ 'o skol rang da lta'i skabs su tshe 'di'i gdos thag bcad nas/ dad pa gsha' ma cig dang ma bral bar byas nas nyams su len na chos gang yang zab pa yin te/ chu gtor gyi zhabs na/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes pa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs te/ sdig pa ci yang mi byed pa'i steng du/ dge ba phun sum tshogs par bya ste/ de nas rang sems 'dul/ rang sems 'dul na sangs rgyas bstan pa bya ba de ka yin/ chos de gcig pu nyams su blangs kyang chog pa yin gsung*/ 'da' ka ye shes las/ dngos po thams cad mi rtag pas na ci la yang mi chags pa'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes bshad pas dngos po mi rtag ste nang gi shes pa 'gyur bas mi rtag la/

phyi'i snang ba'i yul dang lo rgan gzhon grogs mched lcam bza' mi nor rdzas la sogs pa thams cad la rtag pa med pas/ gang la yang mi bden par bzung la nyams su blang dgos/ rang gi lus kyang 'byung ba bzhi ka'i g.yar po yin pas mi rtag ste/ g.yar po 'khyer (5ba)ba la tshegs med/ des na dngos po thams cad mi rtag par 'dug pas ci la yang mi chags par bya'o// sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas zhes pa ni sems nyid rtogs pa zhig la zer ba yin te/ bdag gzhan snang stong*/ don dam kun rdzob/ dbyings ye shes de thams cad dbyer med du shes pa la zer/ de lta bu'i don de gzhan nas btsal bas rnyed pa ma yin te/ rang sems rang gis blta bas shes shing*/ rtogs pa la sangs rgyas zer ba yin te/ ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam// rab dga' zhes ni de la bya// zhes gsungs pas so// de bzhin du yin pas rang gi sems nyid ji lta bar rtogs pa la sangs rgyas zhes bya'o// rang sems sngar mthong ma myong ma mthong ba la mthong bas so// de nyid rang sems rtogs pa las byung bas sangs rgyas gzhan nas ma 'tshol gyi don to// de bzhin du tshe 'di'i 'dun ma thams cad rgyab tu bskyur nas/ nyams su blangs na chos gang gi sgor zhugs kyang don grub nas 'ong ba yin pas/ tshe 'di'i rtsol ba spangs nas nyams su len pa gal che gsung*/ chos bshad cing tshe 'di'i 'dun ma byas na mi nag pa chos kyi lo rgyus mkhan bya bar 'gro ba yin pas/ tshe 'di dang ma 'dres par nyams su len pa gal che/ chos de las ma mchis so// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ 'o skol chos zhe thag pa nas byed pa'i gang zag gis mno bsam dum re btang dgos te/ yang*/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang*// tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas// ngang pas chu la 'o ma len pa bzhin// rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar bya// zhes gsungs te/

tshe thung ste long che ba med/ rgyal chen rigs (6na)bzhi nas 'og min du brtsis/ des dmyal ba la brtsis pas mi tshe thung la/ de'i nang nas 'dzam bu gling pa thung la/ de'i nang nas kyang da lta lo drug cu las lhag pa kun tshe lhag ma la longs spyod pa yin pas/ tshe thung la shes bya'i rnam pa mang ste/ shes bya slob na zad pa dang thug pa med/ chos kyi nang na nyung shos kha 'bar ma'i chu gtor yin te/ kha 'bar ma'i rigs rnyed tshad bris pas mi gcig la dbus kyi ma ki na sgrom gcig gang 'dug gsungs pas/ des na shes bya la zad pa'i mtha' med de/ kha 'bar ma nyung shos la de tsam 'ong na chos gzhan la lta ci smos/ des na shes bya la zad pa'i mtha' med pas bslabs kyis mi lang bas ngang pas chu la 'o ma len pa bzhin rang gi 'dod pas dang du blang dgos te/ dper na rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā la ba rnams brgal bas 'o ma chur zags pas bya ngang pa'i mchu la skyur rtsi yod pa'i mchus chu dkrugs pas chu la 'o ma dum bu long nge 'ong ba de blangs nas bza' ba bzhin du/ rang re 'dod pa ngang du blang ste shes pa sna tshogs pa'i gseb nas rang gi 'dod pa'i gdams pa blang dgos/ gdams pa nyams su blangs pa'i dgos par rang sems la dbang thob nas/ sems las su rung bar byed dgos/ bskyed rdzogs la mos pa rnams kyis/ bskyed rdzogs la sems las su rung dgos/ de la sogs te rtsa rlung thig le nyams su len yang rung*/ don dam kun rdzob zer yang rung*/ phyag rgya chen po zer yang rung*/ rdzogs pa chen po zer yang rung ste/ de thams cad kyi dgos ched sems las su rung ba yin/ sems las su rung ba ji lta bu cig yin snyam na/ sems chos nyid du rtogs pa khong du chud nas/ snying (6ba)rje shugs las byung ba'am/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa la zer ba yin/ snang ba la bden 'dzin chung ba la zer ba yin/ de lta bu ma byung bar du shin tu bsgrims nas nyams su len dgos/

bden 'dzin rang rgyud par dpyad pas sangs rgyas las bde 'gro yang dka' ba yin/ lus las kyang*/ bsgom med sgom pa po'ang med// lha dang sngags kyang yod ma yin// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// shes he badzra las gsungs so// chos de las ma mchis so// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du byas na/ rten gyi gang zag tshe 'di la blo log pa cig gis/ rang 'dod spangs la/ ci byed pa thams cad sems can gyi don du sems bskyed la/ rang la ltos pa med par bya dgos/ jo bo sems can la brten nas sangs rgya ba yin/ sems can la byams pa dang snying rje bskyed/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa re byas la nyams su len dgos te/ rang la 'ub hril gyis dril nas dpyad na/ phyag rgya chen po'i lugs kyis skyon bral gsum gsum nyams su blangs dgos te/ snang ba'i skyon dang bral ba/ stong pa'i skyon dang bral ba/ skye ba med pa'i skyon dang bral ba gsum gsum nyams su blang dgos/ de yang ji ltar nyams su blang na/ snang ba'i skyon dang bral ba de/ snang ba bden par mi 'dzin par nyams su len dgos te/ snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du nyams su blang*/ snang la rang bzhin med par nyams su blang*/ snang ba bden med du shes pas sdug bsngal bden med du shes pa 'ong ba yin/ sdug bsngal rang rgyud du ma song tsam na/ chos chos su song ba (7na)yin/ bdag gzhan gyi snang ba thams cad bden med du shes tsam na/ snang ba skyon bral bya ba yin no// stong pa skyon dang bral ba ni/ stong nyid kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba la zer ba yin te/ stong pa yin/ stong par rtogs par bya snyam nas/ stong par 'dod pa byung ba gol ba yin pas/ nyon mongs pa rnam rtog stong par shes nas sdug bsngal skye ba'i yul stong pa nyid du shes nas mi skye bar 'dug na/

stong nyid skyon bral bya ba yin gsung*/ skye med skyon bral bya ba ni/ snang ba stong pa res 'jog tu ma song ba cig la zer te/ snang ba dang skye med stong pa yang skye med du shes pa de la skye med skyon bral zer ba yin te/ de rang yang gnyis snang gi shes pa dang bral ba gcig la bya'o// don la snang ba skyon dang bral ba zhes bya ba ni snang ba'i mthar zhen pa dang bral ba la zer la/ stong pa skyon bral yang stong pa'i mtha' zhen pa dang bral ba la zer/ skye med skyon dang bral ba na gnyis snang gi mthar zhen pa dang bral ba la zer ba yin pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung lugs kyis/ snang ba'i skyon dang bral ba/ stong pa'i skyon dang bral ba/ skye med kyi skyon dang bral ba/ skyon bral gsum la yon tan sku gsum ste/ snang ba'i skyon dang bral bas 'khor ba'i mtha' zad de snang stong sprul sku/ stong pa'i skyon dang bral te nyan thos dang zhi bde la mi gnas pas 'gag med longs sku/ skye med kyi skyon dang bral bas sems kyi 'dod pa la stong stong pa'i 'dod pa zad de/ skye med chos sku/ de ltar nyams su len pa de rje bram ze chen po'i bzhed pa yin gsung*/ chos de las ma mchis so// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ tshe la long med rgyud la dran pa'i lcag gis bskul zhing*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la blo 'gel (7ba)ba zhig dgos/ de cis shes na tshe mi rtag par 'dug /brgya la tshe ring yang sdod long chen po mi 'dug tsa na bla ma min pa lam ston mkhan mi 'dug /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang bla ma la brten nas sangs rgyas pa yin pas bla ma la bsten pa gal che/ bla ma med pa'i sngon rol na// sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med// ces gsungs/ des na/ bla ma bsten cing ci gsung nyan pa 'di gal che'o gsung*/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la re dgos pa yin/

'o skol chos pa la dkon mchog min pa'i skyabs gnas med/ dkon mchog la blo gsha' mar khel pa yin na/ tshe 'di phyi'i dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba la the tshom ma mchis gsung*/ bla ma dkon mchog la blo bkal nas/ nyams su len pa la 'ub hril gyis dril ba la/ a ro ye shes 'byung gnas kyi lugs kyis/ snang shar yin/ gsum du nyams su len dgos te/ de yang tshig gsum po ste ji ltar du yin snyam na/ cir snang*/ cir shar/ yin na/ ci yin snang ba la phar bltas pas sna tshogs su shar/ sna tshogs su snang ba yin/ nga nyid rang la bltas pas rang gi sems nyid sna tshogs su snang*/ rang sems sna tshogs su shar/ snang shar gnyis ka rang gi sems kyi rtog pa yin/ rtog pa de nyid rang gi sems nyid yin/ de bzhin du yin pas rang gi sems nyid las skyes pas chos nyid de nyid sna tshogs su shar ba yin/ snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba de nyid rang gi sems nyid skye med 'di rang yin/ snang ba dang sems dbyer mi phyed par byed pa rang yang sems nyid rang yin pas/ sems kyi snang ba yin la/ rang sems skye med du shes par byas la bsgom/ byung tshor sna tshogs kyang skye med stong pa chos skur bsgom/ (8na)sems rang bzhin skye med nyams su blangs/ snang ba la bred mi dgos rang sems yin/ bde ba dang gsal ba dang mi rtog pa gang skyes thams cad theg pa chen po'i chos kyi sku'i ngo bo las ma 'das pa yin pas/ de nyid kyi don la skad cig kyang ma yengs par bsgom pa gal che/ snang ba thams cad bden par bzung na/ snang ba thams cad chos kyi sku yin kyang*/ khams gsum 'khor ba las mi 'da'/ skye bo mi nag pa rung*/ de bzhin ma yin pas snying rje phyogs can du mi bya/ phyogs ris kyi byams sems khra dang spyang khu la yang yod de/ des mi phan/ rang gi bu tsha kho na snying rje zer ba de snying rje yin pa'i ngo bo med/ zhen pa bya ba yin/

zhen pa dang snying rje nor sa yod de/ spyang po kun bsam mno bag re thong dang*/ med pa dang ma chags pa nor sa yod de/ de bzhin du lags pas byams snying rje phyogs cha can gyi snying rje ma byed par/ phyogs med sems can la bsgom pa snying phugs su bcug la/ rang gi zhe 'dod du ma song bar nyams su blang 'tshal te/ de yang nyams su len pa la rdzogs chen skor lugs kyis/ gzhung gi tshig gnyis su dril nas nyams su len pa yin pas/ snang srid kyi chos thams cad rang gis sems su dam bca' ba dang*/ de'i don gtan la 'bebs pa gnyis yin te/ de yang snang srid kyi chos thams cad rang rig 'di rang yin/ dga' na yang sems dga' la/ ma dga' na sems ma dga' ba yin/ lung las kyang*/ mtho ris ngan song phyi snod nang bcud rang gi sems// shes gsungs so// de ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sems su thag bcad nas nyams su len/ lo re tsam gyis mi 'ong bas/ de nyams su len pa (8ba)la sems kyi rang bzhin ma skyes par gtan la phab ste/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis chos thams cad la bden pa rang rgyud pa ci yang mi 'dug ste/ ngo bo nyid kyis stong par 'dug pas na/ sems kyi rang bzhin ma skyes par gtan la phebs/ rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du'ang 'dzin pa med/ rig pa phyogs med du shar nas 'dug pas/ sems kyi rol pa ma 'gags par gtan la phebs/ sems kyi ngo bo la ma skyes mi 'gags par gnyis su mi 'jug ste/ rgya mtsho dang rlabs lta bur 'dug pas/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gnyis med du gtan la 'bebs/ gnyis med tsam rang yang blo'i yul mi gnas te/ blo rigs kyis dpyad du med pas blo ngo bo nyid du grol te/ ngo bo gnyis med du gtan la phebs/ 'o na gtan tshigs bzhi po de la dgos pa ci yod byas pa la/ snang ba rang rgyud par song gis dogs pa la rang bzhin skye med du bstan la/ stong pa'i mthar song gis dogs pa la rol pa 'gag med du bstan/

gnyis snang gi mthar shor gyis dogs pa la mtshan nyid gnyis med du bstan/ gnyis med yin snyam na blo nyams kyi lta ba bya ba yin pas/ de'i ngo bo gnyis med du bstan pa yin/ des na gtan tshigs bzhi po des mtha' bzhi'i dngos po 'gags pa'i bar du bstan pa yin pas/ ji srid du blo'i 'dod pa zad zad nyams su blang*/ chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ chos gsha' ma cig byed pa la/ dang po tshe 'di'i rnam rtog ma lus pa spangs nas/ rang dang sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i gang zag des/ dang po mi rtag pa bsgoms nas tshe 'di la blo ldog /de nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms nas 'khor (9na)ba'i chos mtha' dag la blo ldog /de nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms na/ rang rgyud 'byongs par byas nas ma bsgoms nas/ mis kyang zhe khrel byed la nyams rtogs kyang mi skye bas rang sems ci thul bya/ gros thams cad nang du 'debs pa gal che/ rang rgyud rang nang du thul na nang rtags phyir 'char/ de bzhin lags pas 'ub hril gyis dril nas/ snang shar yin gsum du nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs 'bras bu kun 'grub ste/ snang ba sna tshogs bden med du shes par byas la/ sems skye med chos skur shes par byas la bsgom/ byung tshor sna tshogs kyang skye med stong pa chos skur shes par byas la/ sems ma yengs par nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs 'bras bu kun 'grub ste/ chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ chos gsha' ma cig byed pa la 'jig rten 'di las blo log nas byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gal che/ de yang sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde ba dang phrad nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bkod par bya'o// snyam pa de rtag tu ma brjed par byas la/

zhe thag pa nas rang 'dod med par sems can gyi don du dmigs pa gal che ba yin pas sems can blos mi spang*/ sems can blos spang na theg pa chen po'i chos dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyis dang bral ba yin pas nyes pa che/ rang 'dod dang dgra zin du byar mi rung la/ gsang sngags pa'i dbang du byas na yang sems can thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin yin pas/ lha la nyon mongs pa skyer ga la rung*/ phyag rgya chen po'am rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang du byas na yang*/ rang sems snang ba don dam chos sku'i 'od dam/ rgyan nam che ba'i rol ba yin pas/ rang sems chos sku'i 'od dam rgyan la sogs pa la nyon mongs pa skye ga na rung*/ rang sems gcig pu'i don ma yin par sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum (9ba)gyi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ sems can gyi don du lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba ci byas pa thams cad 'gro ba'i don du bsngo dgos te/ de yang nyams su len pa la 'ub hril gyis dril na/ bag chags 'di 'grogs yun ring bas cir snang sgyu mar ma shes bar du nyams su len pa la bsgrim dgos/ dug lnga rang chas su yod pas nyon mongs pa lam du ma slongs bar du/ nyams len la bsgrim dgos/ dus kyi mtha' yun ring bas 'khor ba ma stongs bar du nyams su blang dgos so// bag chags 'dris yun ring bas/ cir snang sgyu mar ma shes bar du nyams su len pa ni/ bag chags kyi las kyis sngun bsu/ bag chags kyi las kyis rjes su 'brang*/ bag chags kyi las de 'phral du 'gro /de bzhin du bag chags dus gsum du rgyu bas/ cir snang thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du khyer bas/ snang ba la bden 'dzin na bun bzhin du yal nas 'gro ba yin/ dug lnga rang chas su yod pas nyon mongs pa lam du ma slongs bar du nyams len dgos/ zhe sdang rang chas su yod pa yin cing*/ skye med kyang rang chas su yod pas zhe sdang skyes tsam na/

skye med kyang skye bar byas la goms pas zhe sdang mi skye ba dang*/ rmi lam sgyu mar shes tsam na lam du slongs pa yin/ de bzhin du nyon mongs pa lnga ka la shes par bya'o// dug lngas ma gos par shes tsam na lam du slongs pa yin no// dug lnga yun ring bas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bsgrim pa ni/ khams gsum gyi spyi mtshan du 'khor ba la thog ma med pas/ gang zag sgos tshan du 'khor ba la thog ma yod par byar rung ste/ nam sangs rgyas na thog mtha' byung ba de rang yin/ de bzhin du khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis nyams su blangs kyin bsgom dgos pa yin/ rang btsan sa ma zin bar du bsgom (10na)pa yin/ gnas skabs su bzang ngan 'ong na ngan pa la g.yengs pas/ de phyir khrid nyen yod/ dper na glang chen gzhan thon yang*/ mjug ma ma thon pa yin na mjug ma'i phyir phyir ldog dgos pa yod pas/ 'khor ba'i 'brel thag ma chod kyi bar du bsgom dgos/ chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos cig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ chos gsha' ma zhig byed pa la/ tshe 'di mi rtag cing long med pas dngos po gang thongs thongs gtong dgos te/ sbyin pa ni me dang chu tsam la slob dgos te/ me chu rang la gtong blo med par shes tsam na 'jur 'gegs kyi yi dwags su skye la/ chung ngu la goms pas mthar chen po mgo dang rkang lag gtong ba 'ong ba dang*/ mig gtong ba 'ong ba la tshegs med pa yin/ de bzhin du song tsam na 'khor ba dang dbyes byas pa yin/ de nas dang po sbyin pa me chu la bslab/ de nas dngos po dman pa la bslab/ de nas rang la dgos dgos po zhen zhen po btang dgos/ de bzhin du nyams su len pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis/ 'ub hril gyis dril ba la 'khor 'das gnyis la tshig gnyis las med de/ lung las/ ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan// bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs// zhes pa ste/

ji ltar 'dzin pa yod ring la kun nas nyon mongs pa yod/ de yang bdag 'dzin las chags pa skye/ bdag 'dzin las sdang ba skye/ bur 'dzin pa las chags pa skye/ dgrar 'dzin pa las sdang ba/ snyan par 'dzin pa las chags pa/ mi snyan par 'dzin pa las sdang ba/ de bzhin du bstod pa las chags pa sogs gnyis snang gi shes pa sna tshogs su bzung bas (10ba)'khor ba las mi thar te/ gtan du sdug bsngal ba'i gnas su 'gro ba yin pas/ de las log pa la bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs par bya bar gsungs/ de bzhin du nyams su len pa la bdag bden nam mi bden blta/ bdag rtag gam mi rtag blta/ bdag la rang bzhin 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ de bzhin du bltas pas bdag mi rtag par mthong bas bdag gi chags pa dang bral/ bdag la zhen pa mi 'dug na zhen pa thams cad dang bral/ de snga phan chad du bdag tu bzung bas bdag gi ba byung*/ bdag dang bdag gir byung bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ bdag gi bu dgra nor de la sogs pa bdag byung bas bdag gi ba mang po byung ba yin/ des 'khor bar 'khyams pa lags/ bdag ni rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes par bya/ bdag mi rtag par shes par bya/ de bzhin du shes pas bdag mi dmigs te// bdag mi dmigs pas bdag gi ba thams cad mi dmigs pa yin pas/ bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs pa rnam par byang bar gsungs/ zhes lung las bshad/ de bzhin du yin pas bdag 'dzin thams cad spang dgos la/ 'khor ba hrul por gtong ba yin pas bdag 'dzin mi dmigs par nyams su blangs dgos/ rnam par byang ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos yin pas/ de bzhin du me dang chu nas rang gi lus sbyin pa'i bar la bslab cing zhen pa thams cad spangs/ chags pa thams cad spangs/ skyon thams cad ngos bzung zhing spang*/ skyon mtshang thams cad gang 'dug blta zhing yul 'don/ phyis nam 'ong mi shes pas/ na ba blo rdeg 'chi ba thog babs 'gyod pa las ngan yin pas da lta rang nas 'bad la nyams su blang 'tshal lo// chos de las ma mchis//

//rnam pa kun la chos gcig (11na)snyan du gsol na/ da lta'i skabs su bsam mno bag re btang 'tshal te/ 'chi ba bya ba nam yong cha med/ 'chi bdag gi zhags pas zin tsa na rang dbang ma mchis/ da lta rang la rang dbang yod dus 'dir nam gzhag gtan gyi so nam re zin par byed dgos te/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la blo dang por bkal dgos te/ dad pa dang 'dun pa mos pa dang gus pas gsol ba drag tu gdab/ tshe 'di'i khe grags dang che bstod la sogs pas chos zhe nas byed pa la phan pa med pas rgyab tu skyur nus 'tshal/ lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma dkon mchog gi phyogs su 'bul zhing*/ nyams len la dril ba cig dgos pas/ sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i ched du bdag gis sbyin pa btang*/ tshul khrims bsrung*/ bzod pa bsgom/ brtson 'grus brtsam/ bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag /shes rab bskyed snyam pa de bzhin du byas la/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan du nyams su blang dgos snyam pa re snying phugs su bcug la/ chos byed pa la 'ub hril gyis dril na don dam kun rdzob gnyis su shes 'tshal/ kun rdzob tu las dang las kyi rnam smin kyang yod la/ skye rga bde sdug la sogs pa kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos thams cad yod/ rnam par byang ba mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ yon tan sku dang ye shes kyang yod ces pha rol tu phyin pa nas bshad/ des na kun rdzob tu gzhan dang bdag gi rnam rtog las gyur ba 'dug gi ring la/ dge sdig bden pa yin pas/ las dge sdig la shin tu 'dzem 'tshal te/ da lta las dge ba bsags na 'bras bu bzang po'i bde ba skye ba phyi ma la smin la/ da lta las ngan sdig pa spyad na phyi ma la 'bras bu (11ba)ngan song gi sdug bsngal smin nas mchi bas/ rgyu med la 'bras bu mi 'byung*/ rgyu log pa dang dman pa las sangs rgyas mi 'byung*/ pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ yon tan yongs su sdud pa'i mdo las/

ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ rgyu dge ba bcu'am/ chos spyod bcu'am pha rol tu phyin pa drug la ma brten na sangs rgyas mi thob pas lta ba kha 'byams su song nas/ shes pa tha mal du lus pa'i nyen che/ zhal nyan pa kun ji srid rang bden gyi ring la gzhan 'gro ba rigs drug kyang bden pa yin/ rang la bden 'dzin med tsa na 'gro ba rigs drug kyang rang sar grol nas 'gro bas/ rang gi bden 'dzin rang sar grol ba cig ma byung bar du kun rdzob bden pa yin/ de srid du rgyu las dang 'bras bu las kyi rnam smin kyang yod pas/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa gal che/ kun rdzob rang sar grol te nga bdag spangs tsa na/ don dam par na las kyi rnam par smin pa med pa yin zhes gsungs te/ don dam gyi bden pa de ci tsam na rtogs pa yin na/ zhe 'dod kyi rtog pa dang*/ rlom pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ brjod pa'i tshig gi tha snyad dang bral nas/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyi rtog pa thams cad rang sar dag nas bdag gzhan gyi snang ba mi 'dug tsam na/ don dam pa de rtogs/ de la las dang las kyi rnam smin kyang med de/ de lta bu'i don rtogs nas 'dug tsa na/ rang don dang bral te/ gzhan don sems can la gang phan gyi don byed pa yin pas/ rtogs pa bzang du song tsa na sems can la snying rje cher 'gro ba yin te/ slob dpon bai ro tsa na'i zhal nas kyang*/ skye shi med pa'i don rtogs kyang*// 'dus byas dge ba rgyun mi gcad// ces gsungs pa'i don de ltar yin pas/ rang (12na)gis don dam rtogs sam kun rdzob snang bas 'dug /rang la lta dgos/ don dam rtogs kyang sems can la snying rje sgom 'tshal/ sems can la phan pa cher gdags dgos/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o// zhes gsungs pas bden gnyis dbyer med du nyams su blang 'tshal/

chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ 'o skol da lta'i dus su tshe la long med pas/ spang bya lhag ma ma lus par spangs shing*/ phyis mi skye bar byed pa'i gnyen po bzang po brten la/ ngo tsha dang dad pa gal che/ de yang dad pa la yal ba'i skabs yod srid pas/ de'i dus su ngo tsha yod na chos dang mi 'bral ba'i grogs mang po byed la/ ngo tsha'i dad pa yang 'ong srid pa yin pas ngo tsha gal che/ ngo tsha med na dad pa rgas pa'i dus su/ chos min gyi las a cang ches na/ 'jig rten na bya mi rung ba'i las pha ma yang gsod pa sogs byed pa la tshegs med/ de lta bu'i las ngan thengs cig byas pas khrel shor nas/ 'dun ma thams cad bca' 'khyal nas 'gro /des na dad pa gcig pus rang rkya mi thub pa yin pas/ ngo tsha dang yang ldan pa gal che/ btsad po shan pa mi byed pa de tsug yin/ dad pa dang ngo tsha 'dzom na cis kyang chos su 'gro ste gser la nag tshur btang ba lta bu yin/ gser kha ye nas bzang ba la nag tshur gyis je bzang la 'gro ba dang 'dra bas/ dad pas chos 'ba' zhig byed pa'i steng du/ ngo tshas gzhan gyis khrel na bdag gzhan gyi don ga na 'grub snyam nas/ mis khrel gyis dogs nas 'phral gyi mdzad spyod phan chod la gzabs nas byas pas/ rang gzhan gyi don thams cad grub nas 'ong ba yin te/ de ltar dad pa dang ngo tsha 'dzom pa'i nyams su blang ba de la/ rgyud la yon tan ci tsam cig skyes nas 'dug lta dgos te/ snang ba thams cad (12ba)bden snang du byas nas bde sdug bdag gzhan/ nor rdzas 'khor g.yog thams cad bden pa rang rgyud par byas na/ mi nag pa tha mal pa dang khyad med pas/ zag bcas kyi bdag 'dzin chung du btang dgos pas/ ci byed thams cad sems can gyi don du ma dmigs na/ theg pa chung ngur 'gro ba yin/ 'bras bu 'phags pa nyan thos las mi thob/ cir snang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes na/

ci byed rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin/ sems can gyi don byed kyin 'dug na/ theg pa chen po'i lam la blo 'byongs pa bya ba yin/ bdag gi zhe 'dod med par rmi lam sgyu ma lta bus gzhan don gtso bor sgrub na byang chub sems dpa' bya ba lags/ bdag rang gces 'dzin gyi rtog pa med par jo bo sems can la ci phan byed la/ 'gro don la sun pa med par 'grub tsa na byang chub sems dpa' bya ba yin/ gzhan gyi rtog pa med par sems can gyi don la 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung gin 'dug tsa na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bya ba yin/ de ltar yin pas snang ba rang rgyud par spyad na so so skye bor gol/ sems can gyi don du ma dmigs na nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas su gol/ de ltar lags pas zhal rnam pa kun kha chos kyis mi phan/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod// ces pas/ dge ba ci byas thams cad gzhan don du mi bsngos na chos kyang lam du 'gro ba dka'/ lam du ma song ba'i chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya/ sangs ma rgyas na 'khor bar skyid med/ de'i phyir na sems can gyi don du sems bskyed re dang bsngo ba re bya/ de lta bu'i gdams ngag shes shing nyams su blang ba gal che/ de bzhin lags pas dang po dad pa gal che/ ngo tshas chos grogs byas nas sems can la byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma min pa cig dgos/ (13na)de yang bdag bas gzhan gces pa cig dgos/ de yang stong pa dang snying rje dus mnyam pa cig 'tshal/ phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud nas/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs pa// de ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no// 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang*// zhes gsungs pa'i don te/ snying rje med pa'i stong pa nyid kyis lam mi chod la/ stong pa med pa'i snying rjes kyang lam mi chod pas/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can du 'khyer dgos pa yin te/

stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhes bshad/ stong nyid snying rje dus mnyam du nyams su long*/ chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ tshe 'di blos btang nas skye ba phyi ma'i don du gnyer ba rnams kyis/ bla ma dam par bdag gzhan 'dres pa'i gdams pa zhus la/ nyams su len pa la sngags rnying ma nas theg pa rim pa dgur bshad kyang rung*/ gsang sngags gsar ma nas rgyud sde bzhir bshad kyang rung*/ mtshan nyid nas sde snod rin po che gsum du bshad kyang rung*/ snying po skor nas theg pa gsum gnas pa bzhi sbyor ba dgur bshad kyang rung*/ thams cad bden pa gnyis sam bzhir bshad kyang rung ste/ 'ub hril gyis dril ba la/ zas kyi bzhu thabs bzhi/ sa'i bzung thabs gsum/ spyod lam rnam pa gnyis te/ chos pa'i spyod pa thams cad der 'dus so// zas la dge 'dun dang bla ma dad pa can la sogs pa mang du 'ong ste/ bzhu thabs rnam pa bzhi ni/ rnal 'byor pa rab kyis rtogs tshad lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan pas/ snang ba'i bden 'dzin zhig nas/ snang ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pas zas bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog bral bas ngang (13ba)gis 'ju ba yin te/ rtogs pas zhu ba rab yin/ de'i 'og ma bsgom pas zhu ba yin te/ gtum mo lta bu bsgom pa cig gis spyir bying rgod bcos dgos kyang*/ 'dir phyi'i skyon thams cad rtsa rlung bsgoms pa rang gis sel ba yin la/ rtsa rlung bsgoms pa las yon tan thams cad mtha' dbus med pa nam mkha' lta bur 'char ba yin/ des 'ju ba ni rnal 'byor pa 'bring yin/ de'i 'og tu byams snying rje mnyam bzhag rjes thob tu bsgom pa cig gis 'ju ste/ mnyam bzhag la goms pa yun ring ba dang*/ dpe tshes gcig gi zla ba dang 'dra ste/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sngon du btang gin bsgoms pas/ ting nge 'dzin mgo skyes pa tsam na sems kyi ngo bo mthong tsam byung nas/

rjes thob bden 'dzin shes chung ngu song ba cig gis 'ju ba yin te/ rnal 'byor pa 'bring smad yin/ de'i 'og tu rnal 'byor pa lus ngag gi dge sbyor rem pa cig gis 'ju ste/ thun bzhir bskyed rdzogs sam phyag dang skor ba mchod pa dang gtor ma bzlas brjod rgyun du byed pa tha ma ste/ 'bring gnyis/ rab dang tha ma/ bzhi po des zas 'ju ba'o// chos pa'i sa'i bzung thabs gsum ni/ ri khrod byas nas rtag tu sa zin na rab yin/ 'dag chal byas nas sa zin na 'bring yin/ bka' lung thob cing sdom pa bsrungs nas sa zin na tha ma yin no// spyod lam gnyis ni/ rab chos la gnas pa'i thog nas sems can la phan ci thogs byed pa'o// tha mas gzhan pha rol po dad cing spyod pa zhi zhing dul bar byed pa yin no// de ltar zas gzhu thabs bzhi po dang sa'i bzung thabs gsum po gal che/ spyod lam gnyis po de med kha med pas/ de ltar lags pas jo bo kun ci thod thod (14na)kyis zas mi 'ju/ chos pa'i gral du yang mi tshud pas/ rang la de tsho gang rung zhig ldan dgos/ grong pa sems 'du 'dzi skye ba'i sar bsdad pa dang*/ sdom pa dang dam tshig mi srung ba'i sar bsdad pas bdag gzhan gnyis ka ngan song du 'gro ba'i grogs byed/ rang chos dang mi ldan na gzhan la skur ba 'debs pas na/ chos pa'i bzung thabs gsum po de gal che/ spyod lam gnyis po de dang ma ldan na/ bdag gzhan gyi don mi 'grub pas/ rgyud sdom pa dang ldan zhing lus ngag yid gsum dul ba dang ldan pas 'gro ba'i don bya/ de tsho las zas 'ju thabs gang rung zhig dang*/ sa bzung thabs gang rung zhig dang*/ spyod lam gnyis po de chos pa la med thabs cis kyang med pas/ de tshe tshogs par gyur na sems can gyi don bya zhing*/ bdag gzhan gyi don nyams su blangs te/ lung las/ bdag gzhan don chen grub pa'i lam zhugs pa// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog

/ces pa/ gzhan don grub na bdag don chen po grub pa ste/ de rang yin pas na bkra shis dam pa de la zer ba yin pas/ de ltar nyams su blang ngo*// chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i chos kyi dbang du bgyis par gda' na/ chos gsha' ma zhig byed par song na/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa rgyud la mi skye ba'i thabs med yong tshe 'di mi rtag par 'dug /der skyes nas ma shi ba mi 'dug pas cis kyang 'chi nges/ da lta 'chi'am nam 'chi cha med de/ tshe la tshad med pas nam 'chi cha med/ lus la snying po med pas nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi rkyen mang ste lus 'di zas kyis gso ste/ (14ba)zas kyis brnangs nas 'chi rkyen byed pa dang*/ lus 'di gos kyis gso ste gos kyis 'thums nas 'chi rkyen la sogs pa mthun rkyen thams cad kyang 'chi rkyen du 'gro zhing 'dug pa/ gzhan dgra dang chu nang la sogs pa 'chi rkyen shin tu mang bar 'dug pas nam 'chi cha med pa'o// 'o na nam 'chi cha mi 'dug na/ 'chi ba la phan pa'i stongs pa yod dam zhe na/ cis kyang mi stongs par 'dug ste/ rang gis bsags pa'i nor gyis kyang mi stongs par 'dug /'chi ba la phyug po'i nor gyis bslur mi 'dug /nor bzhag nas rang gcig pus sangs kyis 'gro bar gda'/ 'o na gnyen 'brel gyis mtha' bskor kyang*/ 'chi ba la mi stongs par slar rang la gnod par gda'/ 'o na rang gi lus 'di srog 'dzin pa yin pas 'chi ba la stongs sam snyam na/ rang gi lus la sogs pa cis kyang mi stongs par 'dug pas kham ches te ma go /de bzhin du byas pas 'chi nges par gda'/ nam 'chi ma nges par gda'/ nam 'chi cha mi gda'/ 'chi ba la cis kyang mi stongs par gda' bas/ da dge sbyor la le lor bzhag tu ga na khom pas/ nyams len byed dgos par gda'/ a tsa ma sos dal du sdod khom pa ci yin snyam nas/ snying med po snyam pa'i blo sna thung sbud pa re snying phugs su gzhug dgos par gda'/

nyams su len pa la tshe 'di'i 'dun ma kun rgyab tu bskyur la// bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten dgos te/ bla ma med na thar pa'i lam stor ba lta bu yin te/ lung las kyang*/ yon tan thams cad rab ldan yang*// bla ma med na srid mthar min// skya ba 'dzin pa med pa yis// grus ni pha rol phyin mi 'gyur// zhes (15na)gsungs so// gzhan yang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// bla ma dag la bsten te byung*// bla ma med pa'i pha rol na// sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med// ces gsungs pas na/ des na bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten la/ rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad bla ma la 'bul/ de las byung ba'i dus gsum gyi dge ba thams cad jo bo sems can dang thun mong du bsngo zhing sems bskyed pa dang*/ bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa dang mos pa ci byas pa thams cad rang 'dod med par sems can gyi don du dmigs la/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis byas pa'i dge ba thams cad dmigs pa med pa'i rtsi yis zin pa gal che ba yin/ chos gang la yang ma dmigs na ting nge 'dzin/ gang la zhen pa dang*/ ji srid du dmigs pa de rtse gcig yin la/ dmigs med du song tsa na spros bral yin/ cir snang sems su shes tsa na ro gcig yin/ nyams la rgyun chad med tsa na bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor yin pas/ de bzhin nyams su blangs pas rang don dang gzhan don gnyis ka 'grub ste/ chos de las ma mchis// //sgom chen pa rnams la chos gcig snyan du gsol na/ 'o skol da lta'i gnas skabs su tshe mi rtag yun thung bar 'dug pa theg pa chen po'i blo bag re skye 'tshal te/ chos nyams su len pa la 'ub hril gyis dril na/ rnal 'byor gsum bya ba cig nyams su len dgos te/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang rdzas dang chos dang bya ba gsum yin te/ de yang dgyes rdor nas/ sngags dang rdzas dang chos rnams ni// rnal 'byor 'di gsum rdzogs gyur na/

'khor ba'i gnas su bsdad (15ba)don med// ces so// de yang sngags kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba de/ bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa phrin las gang gi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin te/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor du bsgoms na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// lha de yang chu zla'am/ sgyu ma'am/ 'ja' tshon lta bur shes pa de rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// de bzhin du bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsgoms na tshogs rnam pa gnyis rdzogs pa yin te/ de nyid kyis sangs rgyas pa yin/ bskyed pa'i rim pa rkyang pa ltar bsgoms kyang ngan song gi sgo khegs pa yin/ de ltar bsgoms pas sngags kyi tshul khrims yin/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor yin no// rdzas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ nor rdzas thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar shes pa yin te/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas snang ba la bden 'dzin zhig nas 'gro ba yin pas/ rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes pa'i stobs kyis rang rgyal dang byang chub sems dpa'i sa la 'gro ba yin te/ lung las kyang*/ sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la// sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms byas na// sgyu ma lta bur sangs kyang rgya// zhes gsungs pas so// chos kyi rnal 'byor ni/ chos thams cad nam mkha' dag pa'i dkyil ltar rtogs nas/ bdag gzhan dang yin min la sogs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa zhig la zer ba yin/ lung las/ nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la// nam mkha' lta bur bsgoms byas na// nam mkha' lta bur sangs kyang rgya// de ltar du rnal 'byor gsum du nyams su len pa yin te/ sngags bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi phrin las la mos na sngags kyi rnal 'byor bya la/ rdzas kyi rnal 'byor la bde na rmi lam sgyu ma'i gdams pa bsgom pa yin/ chos kyi rnal 'byor la mos (16na)na chos thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsgoms pa yin/ 'o na rnal 'byor gsum ka stan thog cig tu ji ltar bsgom na/ dang po bskyed rdzogs bsgom/

de nas spyod lam bzhi'am mthun mtshams la rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ gang byas pa'i rjes thams cad dmigs med nam mkha'i dkyil ltar yid la mi byed par bzhag /de bzhin du nyams su blangs pas bdag gzhan gyi don thams cad grub nas 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de bzhin du nyams su blang*/ chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i chos kyi dbang du bgyis pa lags na/ chos gsha' ma zhig byed pa la/ da lta'i blo skabs su rten mi lus thob/ dbang po sgo lnga tshang*/ dam pa'i chos dar sar skyes/ tshe sngon ma'i bsod nams 'di bsags pa las byung ba'i rten 'di la/ rang shi nad kyis ma thebs pa 'di la chos shig nyams su blang dgos te/ de yang nyams su blang rgyu la/ spang bya mi dge ba bcu spang*/ dge ba bcu sgrub pa gal che/ de yang mi dge bcu spong ba ni/ lus kyi gsum spong*/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum spong ngo*// dge ba bcu ni lus kyi srog gcod spangs pa'i steng du srog 'don grub tshad bya/ ma byin par len pa spangs pa'i steng du/ sbyin pa grub tshad bya/ 'dod log spangs pa'i steng du tshangs spyod kyi sdom pa bsrung ngo*// ngag gi rdzun spangs pa'i steng du chos bshad/ phra ma la gsum/ btsan phra/ gzhogs phra/ lkog phra'o// btsan phra ni gnyis tshogs pa'i rtsar bcug pa de yin/ gzhogs phra ni thabs kyis 'byed pa de yin/ lkog phra lkog nas so sor 'jug pa de yin/ de gsum spangs pa'i steng du tshig 'jam po smra (16ba)ba'o// ngag 'khyal pa spangs pa'i steng du smra bcad bya'o// brnab sems spangs pa'i steng du gzhan gyi 'byor pa la dga' ba bsgom/ gnod sems spangs pa'i steng du gzhan la phan pa ci 'grub bya/ log lta spangs pa'i steng du las sdig pa byas pa bshags/ dge ba byas pa la rjes su yi rang ba bsgom pa'o// de ltar mi dge ba bcu spangs nas gnyen po dge ba bcu dang*/

pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su blangs/ de yang ya ma bral ba yin te re re la drug ka tshang ba yin/ de yang thabs shes rab zung 'jug yin pas/ sbyin pa gtong zhing smin pa'i rnam smin las de ka la rmi lam sgyu mar lta bur shes par bya'o// drug ka la rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o// de yang rgyal ba'i bka' nas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul/ lam mtshan ma med pa'i tshul gyis spyod ces drug ka la sbyar nas gsungs so// de bzhin du yin pas chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu'am gzhi ma lta bu ni mi dge ba bcu spongs/ dge ba bcu sgrub pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gzhan don du nyams su blang ba yin no// chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ chos gsha' ma zhig byed pa la 'jig rten gyi chos la grogs ye med par shes pa zhig dgos te/ 'jig rten 'khrul pa 'di la phar bltas pas/ byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// ci la bsams kyang phan par mi 'dug na// rang gi sems la lta ba rtag tu goms par gyis// shes gsungs so// de ltar lags pas 'o skol da lta'i blo skabs su/ sems la rtag tu bsam mno dum re btang dgos (17na)te/ 'jig rten pa'i chos la phar bltas tsa na byas pa thams cad don mi 'dug ste/ yul mkhar ji tsam yod kyang bzhag nas 'gro dgos pas byas pa yang don med/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad chos min 'ba' zhig tu song*/ nyin par bya ba'i las la song bas brel ba'i ngang*/ nang nub lto'i 'dun mar song bas chos la bya ba'i skabs mi 'dug pas brel sdug don med du 'dug /tshe 'di ma sos kyis dogs nas sdig sdug gtam ngan la ma 'dzems par dung dung byas pas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig tu song*/ tshe 'dir yang sdug bsngal la phyi mar yang ngan song du skye bas sdug bsngal te/

dug gsum po 'di la bltas pas chags pa phyi nang gnyis ka dung dung byas nas ngo tsha ba la ma bltas par bsgrubs pas/ tshe 'dir sems tshong khe'i dbang du song bas/ shi nas yi dwags su skye bas sdug ste don med yin/ zhe sdang gis tshe 'dir kam kam rtsig rtsig byed cing shi ba la ma blta bas rang rgyud bsregs pas tshe 'dir sdug /phyi mar dmyal bar skye bas sdug la don med pa yin/ gti mug gis dge sdig ngo ma shes pas/ 'bog chol spyad cing gnas lugs dge sdig gi mgo ltag ma byed par/ spyang spyang grung grung bzhin du khram dang zol la sogs pa byas kyin spyang po 'dun med po byas pas/ tshe 'dir ci la yang ngoms pa dang chog shes med la dal ba skad cig kyang med pas sdug /phyi mar dge sdig ngo ma shes pas dud 'gror skye sdug bsngal de don med du song*/ des na 'jig rten bya ba thams cad la don med sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'dug pas/ ci la bsams kyang phan par mi 'dug na/ spyang po kun soms dang rang 'chi ba'i nang par cis kyang phan pa med/ bu tsha gces (17ba)shing phongs pa dang 'bral bar 'dug /yul dang 'khor la sogs pa thams cad dang bral te 'gro tsa na/ de nas gal po che ci yod kyang*/ gtam tshig gcig gam/ mi gcig mi mthong ba kham ches te ma bsams pa lags so// lung las/ 'chi ba'i dus su ci la bltas kyang phan par mi 'dug na/ ji ltar bya zhus pas/ bu cis kyang phan par mi 'gyur bas/ rang gis sems la rtag tu goms par gyis gsung*/ rang sems bltas na phan te bde ba yin/ 'o na lta lugs ji ltar bltas na bde na/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags nas 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs la lta bar byed na sems la blta ba bya ba yin pas/ sngags kyi bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyi don la mos pa byed na yang sems la blta ba bya ba yin/ mnyam gzhag la snang ba thams cad sems su shes nas/ rang sems la bltas pas dbyibs dang kha dog kyang ma grub/

ngos bzung thams cad dang bral bar 'dug pas/ yin min gyi mtha' thams cad dang spros pa thams cad rang bzhin rang sar grol te/ gang la yang blo mi 'jug par 'dug na/ mnyam gzhag gi sems la blta ba yin te/ sems la blta ba rnal ma de yin no// rjes thob tu rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms na yang sems la blta ba lags/ de bzhin du sems la blta ba rtag tu goms par bya'o// de bzhin nyams su blangs pas chos nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro ba yin no// chos nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por song nas 'dug na/ sems la ltar btub pa yin/ chos nas/ nyon mongs pas ni sems dkrugs shing*// mi shes 'dam du bying ba yis// zhes gsungs te/ de bzhin du yin pas chos nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por song ba shin tu (18na)gal che'o// lar nyams len rab cig byas na 'chi rgyu med pa'i don rtogs/ nyams len 'bring du byas na lam sna zin/ nyams len tha ma zhig byas na ngan song du mi skye/ des na nyams len la 'bad pa gal che bas bsgom pa gal che ste/ ma bsgoms par 'dod pa las blo log pa nyung*/ bdag nyid 'chi ba las kyang mi grol bas/ de'i phyir na bsgom pa gal che/ bsgoms pas snang ba zil gyis non pas/ bden par 'dzin pa thams cad kyang rang sar grol ba yin pas bsgom pa gal che/ bsgom rgyu'i dngos po rang cig yod dam zhe na/ bsgom med sgom pa po yang med// ces bshad pas/ bsgom rgyu'i dngos po 'di yin bya ba med kyis/ don dam nyams su len pa de la bsgom pa zhes bya ba yin/ de bzhin du nyams su blang*/ chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ da lta'i dus su tshe la skad cig yud tsam las mi gda' bas/ dal 'byor dbang po tshang ba thob dus 'di la/ byang chub kyi lam sna gcig ma zin na 'chi bas/ sangs rgya bar byed pa la rgyu tshang la ma nor ba zhig dgos te/ rgyu med pa dang*/

nor ba dang*/ dman pa las mi 'byung bas/ de yang tshogs gnyis ma bsags pa dang*/ mu stegs kyi lta sgom spyod pa dang*/ theg pa chung ngu nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las sangs rgyas mi 'byung ste/ 'o na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis sangs rgyas mi thob pa ci'i phyir byas pa la/ sems can gyi don du sems mi bskyed par rang gcig pu zhi bde thob par 'dod cing*/ gzhan don du ma dmigs pas thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'byung*/ 'o na sangs rgyas thob pa la (18ba)ji lta bu zhig nyams su len dgos na/ rgyu med pa'i mthar ma shor bar nyams su blang*/ lam nor ba dang*/ dman pa ma yin par nyams su blang*/ de ltar nyams su len pa la/ mi phod pa la thog brdzis te 'khri ba bcad/ zhen pa bzlog /skyon ngos bzung*/ mtshang yul nas 'don/ bde sdug thams cad chos nyid du khyer/ de la dang po mi phod pa la thog brdzis bya ba ni/ gang la chags pa yang ngo tsha la sogs pa gang dgar btang ba'o// de nas 'khri ba bcad pa ni/ bu nor yul la sogs pa thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur 'dug /mi rtag mi bden par 'dug /rang bzhin med par 'dug snyam pa gal che/ de nas zhen pa bzlog pa ni/ de yang lung las/ gang la zhen pa 'dug na de yang thong*// gsungs pas/ gang la zhen pa thams cad spang zhing btang ba'o// skyon ngos bzung ba ni/ dug gsum la skyon du blta bas bdag 'dzin gyi skyon spang*/ mtshang yul nas 'don pa ni/ dug gsum gyis ngan song gsum du 'khyam dogs yod pas/ yul kun gzhi la 'don no// de rnams spang bar byas la theg pa chen po'i blo sna dang ldan par byas la/ sems can thams cad byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis bzung la/ sems can thams cad la de kho na yin par bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob na ci ma rung snyam pa zhig snying phugs su bcug la/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol ba yin pas/

nang par mal nas yar langs dus su/ de ring sems can thams cad kyi don du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol bar bya snyam pa'i sems bskyed re gal che ba yin te/ de bzhin du byas na de'i nyin par ci byas (19na)sems bskyed bzang po des dge bar 'gyur/ chos thams cad la sems bskyed kyis bsgyur ba gtso che bas/ spyir yang sems bskyed bzang po gal che/ ci byas dge bar 'gyur ba yin/ sems bskyed ngan na sdig par 'gro ba yin/ sems bskyed bzang po nang gi g.yog po legs pa dang 'dra ba yin pas/ nub mo nyal dus su yang lus ngag yid gsum dge bas sems can gyi don du 'gro ba de gal che/ de bzhin du byas pas ci byas thams cad dge bar 'gro ba'i stobs kyis lam sna zin pa yin pas/ sems bskyed bzang ba gal che/ de bzhin du sems bskyed byas pas bde sdug thams cad dang*/ skye ba da lta'i skabs su tshe 'di las blo log par byas la/ nyams su len pa hub med du chos sku'i rang bzhin du khyer/ chos de las ma mchis// //rnam pa kun la chos gcig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ 'o skol da lta'i skabs su tshe 'di la blo log par byas la/ nyams su len pa la 'ub hril gyis dril na/ gang gis kyang dgos pa med snyam pa zhig blo phugs su bcug la/ de nas nyams su len pa la/ rnal 'byor bzhi nyams su len dgos te/ de yang rnal 'byor bzhi ni dang po rtse gcig rnal 'byor zhes bya/ de nas spros bral/ de nas du ma ro gcig /de nas bsgom du med pa'o// de ltar bzhi las dang po rtse gcig ni/ dang po sems 'dzin gang rung gcig gi steng du sems tsen ne zin nas/ rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i sgom ngos 'dzin pa zhig yin la/ sems dmigs pa gcig las mi 'phro bar bsdad pa de bskyangs na/ spros bral gyi don 'char/ chos thams cad spros pa'i mtshan ma dang bral bar shes nas sngar gyi thos (19ba)bsam byas pa thams cad phyi shun lta bur song bas/

sems la chags med cig 'ongs/ dus der bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul/ chos gang zab la blta ba dang nyan pa la sogs pa byas shing*/ rtogs pa brtan du gzhug dgos pa yin/ de lta bu rtogs pa'i dus su da ni chos bya rgyu rang mi 'dug ste/ bla ma dkon mchog dang yi dam yang med/ bsgrub dang bsgrubs pa'i dngos grub med zer nas/ dus der bla ma la mos gus 'chor ba dang*/ bar chod kyi bdud 'ong nyen yod pa yin/ bla ma la gsol ba drag tu gdab pa dang*/ dkon mchog yi dam mchod pa dang*/ byams snying rje phyogs ris med par bsgom pa dang*/ nga rgyal med pa zhig gal che gsung*/ mos gus la 'gyur ldog byung na nyams la 'gyur ldog 'ong*/ rang la bar chad 'byung bas bla ma la mos gus rgyun chad med par bya/ nyams rtogs mos gus la rag lus pas/ lam dang nyams rtogs bla mas byed la/ gsang sngags theg pa'i lugs kyis/ byin rlabs bla ma'i lam bya ba yin gsung*/ de ltar byas pas nyams rtogs rgyun chad med pa 'ong gsung*/ de ka ltar bskyangs pas du ma rog cig tu 'char te/ du ma ro gcig shar tsam na snang ba thams cad sems su shes/ sems stong par ro gcig /stong pa skye med du ro gcig par skye'o// dus der yang bla ma dang rdo rje spun mthong bas ma dad pa skyes na bar chad kyi bdud yin pas/ dus der bla ma dang dkon mchog la lus dang longs spyod 'bul/ gsol ba gdab/ bla ma gcig pa'i mched grogs sam sgom chen nyams can la rtogs pa bsdur/ zla 'od gzhon nu'i chos zab zer bar blta/ mdo rgyud dang (20na)bstan bcos chen po mnyan pa gal che gsung*/ du ma ro gcig skyes nas bar chad 'ong ngam snyam na/ rtog pa ma chad bar du bar chad kyang mchi/ du ma ro gcig skyes nas phrag dog 'ong mi srid de/ dag pa'i snang ba shar ba bya ba yin pas/ yi dam gyi zhal mthong ba dang*/ mngon shes bag re 'byung gsung*/

yon tan ci byung yang bden par ma bzung*/ sems su shes pas rtogs pa gong nas gong du sbyangs pas bsgom du med pa'i rtogs pa 'char ste/ sgom bya ba blos bden par bzung nas bsgom pa ni/ bsgom med byams snying rje med pa la zer ba yin gsung*/ bsgom med rang la snying rje dang tshogs gnyis bral ba'i bsgom med cig yod de 'di min/ 'di yi bsgom med 'gro 'ong med pa dang rigs gcig tu bsres pas bsgom bya rtogs pa dang*/ bsgom med 'dzin pa med pa la zer ba yin/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa yang de rang yin te/ 'dzin pa dang zhen pa dang bden 'dzin dang*/ zhe 'dod kyi dmigs gtad thams cad rang sar grol nas sems nyid yin lugs de rang ma bcos par 'jog pa de rang yin gsung*/ de yang nyams su len lugs ni/ dang po rtse gcig la bslab/ de nas spros bral/ de nas ro gcig /de nas bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor chen po la bslab ste/ lam gyi rtsol sgrub dang bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'o// de las byung ba'i yon tan ni/ tshogs bsags/ lam bgrod pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pas rang sems rtogs pas rang don chos sku nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu thob/ lus rdo rje'i skur gyur pas longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' 'am sprin (20ba)lta bu 'thob/ gzhan don du thugs rjes sprul pa'i sku/ gdul bya gang du phyogs su ma lhung ba nam mkha' las char bab pa lta bus 'gro ba sems can la nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi don 'bad rtsol mi dgos par rgyun mi chad par lhun grub tu 'byung gsung*/ 'o skol chos bshad pa thams cad kyis thun re la sngon 'gro sems can gyi don du blo 'phangs/ bar du dge sbyor gyi bya rgyu re/ tha ma bsngo ba dang bcas pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba re ston shes dgos la/ nyan pas kyang de ltar shes dgos pa yin/

chos de las ma mchis so// //bla ma rin po che lha rjes gsungs pa la/ bla ma sgom tshul gyis yang yang nan tan byas nas/ rnam thar gzhan dang ma 'dres par bla mas gsungs pa las ma chad ma lhag par gsung sgros gru bzhi lam me yi ger bris/ bla ma'i bka' srol mi gcig pa dang*/ mos pa med pa dang*/ nyams su mi len pa la mi spel 'tshal/ 'di'i brgyud pa la gnyis te/ sngags dang bka' gdams gnyis yin/ sngags kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis tai lo pa dang bram ze chen po la/ des nā ro mai tri/ des mar pa la/ des mi la ras pa/ des bla ma lha rje la'o// brgyud pa gcig ni/ shākya thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med/ zhi ba lha/ gser gling pa/ a ti sha /'brom ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ rgya sgom/ bla ma lha rje rin po che/ bla ma sgom tshul/ de nas rim par brgyud pa'o// tshogs chos chen po rdzogs so// //dge'o//
